comments: 1fafbea0: ;Call the DE subroutine to set up variables needed for Data Entry.
9a6e8e99: ;Set up variables needed for Data Entry, including the file number, DIE, DIC, DP, DL, DIEL, and DU. Also, check if there are any existing multiple entries and quit if none exist.
648fe8ac: ;If the .01 field (DT) contains a value, store the 5th piece (descending date/time) in DE(1).
3e781027: ;Clean up the %Z variable.
e7d2c77f: ;Write a prompt to the screen at the specified column.
3fd42039: ;(No comment provided)
ce191f1f: ;Write the prompt, and if the output wraps to a new line, shift over for readability.
40203be7: ;If the field is longer than 19 characters, and is not a WORD-PROCESSING field, and is either FREE TEXT or a SET OF CODES, branch to the RW^DIR2 routine to handle input.
3a45118f: ;If the field is REQUIRED, WORD-PROCESSING, and the DE array is defined, write a message that no editing is allowed.
4c6ffc5b: ;Read user input into X, setting a timeout if specified. If the timeout is reached or the user enters an up-arrow, set DTOUT=1 and X to the up-arrow character.
d56bf464: ;(No comment provided)
db688dfc: Increment the MUMPS stack level counter DQ
514bbdf9: Branch execution to the location specified by DQ
6541d4e4: If the current MUMPS stack level DQ has a defined incoming array, go to the PR label; otherwise, execute W (write), TR (transform)
e4252be0: If X is empty, either go to A (if DV doesn't contain 'R'), jump based on DV value (if D is not greater than 0), or go to A
8ba88d47: If X starts with '?', go to QS label; if X contains '^', execute D code and jump to ^DIE17
e4f4d019: If X is '@', execute D code and jump to Z^DIE2

fa4b592b: If X is a space, DV contains 'd' but not 'P', and the DUZ user has a defined DIE value for the current file/field location DLB, set X to that value; if DV doesn't contain 'D' or 'S', write X preceded by two spaces

cf3d64d9: If DV is defined, go to M^DIE17; if DV contains 'V', go to ^DIE3; if DV doesn't contain 'S', go to P label; if the current file's DIFLD field has code defined at ^DD(DP,DIFLD,12.1), execute that code; set % to the external value in DU corresponding to the internal value X, and set Y=X; if % is non-empty and DIC('S') is defined, execute DIC('S') code; if no DB array element is defined for the current MUMPS stack level DQ, write '  ' followed by %; go to V label

b7e13476: Loop through each ';' piece of DU: set Y to the piece value, set DG to the piece position of the first occurrence of ':'_X in Y, set YS=Y, set Y to the value before the first ':' in Y; if DG is non-zero and DIC('S') is defined, execute DIC('S') code; quit the loop if DG is non-zero
c99bc3eb: If no DB array element is defined for the current MUMPS stack level DQ, write the substring of YS starting at position DG; set X to the value of YS before the first ':'
4cd0ac62: If user is adding new entry, quit if they hit '^' or timeout.
5f20d47e: For free text response, if input is longer than 24 characters, delete and re-enter.
9e5267d5: Reformat decimal numbers and remove trailing zeroes.
80c0d498: Execute 'X' cross-reference and clear YS variable.
49d652f9: Store the final value in DG(DW) and ^DISV for audit trail if the DV parameter contains 'd'. Quit if value is undefined.
6c01f7d5: If there is data in the ^TMP global, branch to the Z^DIE17 label.
650f87d5: If this is an invalid response, set X to '?BAD'.
ed876a4b: Store the value of X in DZ, execute the D and QQ^DIEQ routines, and then branch to the B label.
801e4858: Set D to the current field number, DQ(DQ) to the field's label, value, user, word-processing characteristics, and executable help text (from the DATA section). Then quit.

8e880463: If there is no data in the DD global for this field, execute the O routine. If X is not '@' and DV doesn't contain 'R', branch to RD. If X is '@' and DV contains 'R', branch to A. If X is '@', set X to Y and branch to N.
39157ea2: Set DG to DV, Y to the data in the DD global for this field, and X to the user. If there is a DIEQ transform, execute it. Then branch to RP.

62858dda: If DG contains 'P' and there is a file with the number in X, set X to the second piece of the zero node (the entry number). If there is no data at the Y subscript, branch to RP. Otherwise, set Y to the name and X to the INPUT transform from the .01 field, and DG to the second piece of the zero node (the global root). Branch back to R.

c5661acf: If DG contains 'V' and Y is numeric and the second semi-colon piece is CODE, set X to the entry number from the CODE global. If there is no data at the Y subscript, branch to RP. Otherwise, set Y to the name. If there is a DD global, set DG to the global root from the .01 field and X to the INPUT transform, then branch to R.
2e9e6551: If DG contains 'D', execute the standard data dictionary functions. If DG contains 'S', set Y to the external value by parsing the semi-colon pieces.
fce7de78: ;If 'key' X value is defined, execute code for READ access. If not a new-style cross-reference, if DV contains 'I' or '#', or if DC is less than 2, quit.
417eda61: ;If DV doesn't contain 'I' or '#', go to RD (read access).
6d72b00d: ;Execute code for EDIT access. If X is defined, go to RD. Otherwise, go to PR (pre-edit program).
fadb190c: ;Quit.
b73daf7a: ;Set variables for the DATE SIGNED field. DNM is the name of the input template, DQ is the sequence number.
05d8d0cf: ;Set variables for the DATE SIGNED field. DW is the input variable, DV is the MUMPS code for validation, DU is the user's input, DLB is the field label, DIFLD is the field number.
5c592aa3: ;Go to RE (input transform).
71625bb3: ;Execute code for input transform. Set %DT options, call the %DT utility, and set the X variable based on the returned value Y.
83f12f3e: ;Quit.

5389a55f: ;If DG is defined, execute code for HELP access. Set variables, call X2, and execute code based on the value of Y. If Y is defined but empty or equal to U, go to A. Otherwise, set X to Y, set DIC(0) for LAYGO access, set DW to the sequence number, and go to OUT^DIE17.
06c06e68: ;If X is defined and less than the DATE DICTATED, display an error message and clear the DATE SIGNED field. Set Y to '@6' to trigger a LOOP.
269d97b7: ;Quit.

bd649899: ;If DG is defined, execute code for HELP access. Set variables, call X3, and execute code based on the value of Y. If Y is defined but empty or equal to U, go to A. Otherwise, set X to Y, set DIC(0) for LAYGO access, set DW to the sequence number, and go to OUT^DIE17.
d200916b: ;If X is empty, set DGJTST to 'TRANSCRIBED' and Y to '@2' to trigger a LOOP.
38b67c36: ;Quit.
b0192e35: ;If DG is defined, execute code for HELP access, then go to ^DGJXA14.
